To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the effectiveness of psychorehabilitation of mental patients should be evaluated by a set of criteria, which includes both quantitative and non numerical (qualitative) indicators.

the effectiveness of rehabilitation is a complex, multidimensional phenomenon and can not be assessed by a single indicator, and that the effectiveness of psychorehabilitation should be assessed in the context of the hierarchical structure of mental pathology and rehabilitation goals.

the effectiveness of psychorehabilitation is assessed by means of multidimensional, hierarchical criteria, which take into account the clinical and psychopathologic, socio-environmental and personal indicators of the patient.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problems of assessment of psychosocial treatment and rehabilitation of patients with mental diseases, and the main results of the research can be summarized as follows.
the development of a system of criteria for the effectiveness and evaluation of the results of psychosocial treatment and rehabilitation.
developing the methodology of assessment of the effectiveness and efficiency of rehabilitation of mental health patients.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
psychosocial interventions are a necessary and important element in the treatment of mental illness.
the effectiveness of rehabilitation should be assessed by a set of criteria and tools that are most relevant for a given patient, his or her family and the environment.

the effectiveness of psychopharmacotherapy should be assessed not only on the basis of the results of biological studies, but also taking into account the results of clinical and social studies of the patient.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the effectiveness of rehabilitation is determined by the extent of the patient's recovery from the disease, the improvement of his mental state, social behavior and the quality of his life, as well as by the degree of his compliance with the rehabilitation program.

the effectiveness of rehabilitation should be evaluated in a complex way, taking into account all its components and stages, including the assessment of the results achieved by the patient and the effectiveness of the rehabilitation process itself.

the effectiveness of the rehabilitation of patients with mental disorders should be evaluated on the basis of a comprehensive assessment of their mental state (psychopathological, social behavior, compliance, social functioning) and environmental factors (family, social, economic, cultural and other).
The main takeaway from our work is that

the evaluation of the effectiveness of the psychosocial rehabilitation of patients with schizophrenia should be based on the use of a set of indicators, including both the quantitative and qualitative ones.

the assessment of rehabilitation effectiveness should be based on the use of a comprehensive approach, taking into account the hierarchical nature of mental disorders, and should include the use of both quantitative and qualitative indicators of the results of the treatment.

the effectiveness of psychorehabilitation should be considered in terms of the hierarchy of the goals and objectives of the rehabilitation process, the structure of which should be based on the hierarchy of the problems of psychopathology.
